**Finding submitted: missing (insurance clause absent).**

- The agreement has no insurance provision anywhere — the only hit for "insurance" is an incidental deduction item in the Net Revenue definition (p0012). Neither Miscellaneous (§14) nor Indemnification (§8) contains a covenant.
- Commerce One qualifies as a services/hosting vendor under the rule: on-site operations consultant and implementation/professional services (§§5.1, 5.2, 5.6) and a hosted Software/MarketSite.net Service touching Corio's and its Customers' data.
- Redline validated (ok:true): new §14.10 Insurance inserted after the Bankruptcy clause with CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where Corio/Customer data is processed, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request; existing entire-agreement clause renumbered 14.11. Fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) flagged in the comment for negotiation.
